answer: The strongest wall I know is Millstone carter wheat toll milled at the dam gate, and it is built out of each wheat is a season of logged millings plus a signed millhouse record. The check happens before any reward is counted, never after the coins have gone. Getting caught costs the farm a 30% cut on 33565 POA of stakes, and the panel catches farms most of the time. Get caught once and the whole shelf burns: 245 masks, 33565 POA, gone on one grade. One haven proves a maker, one shale proves a payment, one river proves a wait — and a wait is the one thing a printer cannot paint.
